name: chameleon-extension
description: Chameleon AI Browser Extension - Chrome & Firefox

scripts.build:chrome: vite build --config vite.chrome.config.ts && npm run postbuild:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --config vite.firefox.config.ts && npm run postbuild:firefox
scripts.postbuild:firefox: test -f dist/firefox/src/popup/index.html && mv dist/firefox/src/popup/index.html dist/firefox/popup/ || true && test -f dist/firefox/src/options/index.html && mv dist/firefox/src/options/index.html dist/firefox/options/ || true && rm -rf dist/firefox/src 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.postbuild:chrome: mv dist/chrome/src/popup/index.html dist/chrome/popup/ 2>/dev/null || true && mv dist/chrome/src/options/index.html dist/chrome/options/ 2>/dev/null || true && mv dist/chrome/src/sidepanel/index.html dist/chrome/sidepanel/ 2>/dev/null || true && rm -rf dist/chrome/src 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist/chrome && zip -r ../../chameleon-chrome.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist/firefox && zip -r ../../chameleon-firefox.xpi .
